meta.title: Jerrell Niu — Author and Founder, I Love Digital
meta.description: Jerrell Niu writes every guide on ilovedigital.com.au. He builds the websites and runs the search work he writes about, for Queensland businesses.

name: Jerrell Niu
imageAlt: Jerrell Niu, founder of I Love Digital

hero.heading: Jerrell Niu
hero.sub: I make technology simple with clear definitions, real-live examples and explanations that anyone can grasp. I draw on a thirty-year career across health, finance, recruitment and software development. I have owned businesses and worked inside enterprises, and I have managed departments and high-performance teams. That range means each guide comes from someone who has made the call and lived with the result.

bio.heading: Experience.
paragraphs: Everything here comes out of client work. I build the websites, run the search and the reporting, and sit in the meetings where the results get explained. Each guide describes what actually moved the numbers on a real Australian business.

items.title: Websites
items.body: I build websites in Next.js, Shopify, WordPress, Squarespace and Wix, and design them in Figma. I write the code myself, so these guides cover what breaks as well as what works.

items.title: Search
items.body: I run technical SEO, on-page work, Google Business Profile and AI search for clients. Every result is measured in Google Search Console on live accounts, which is where the figures in these guides come from.

items.title: Socials
items.body: I write content calendars, captions and scripts for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. They are built for small teams who have to run social alongside the actual job.

items.title: Consulting
items.body: I do fractional CTO work and build the automation and systems that take admin off a business owner's desk. The tooling and workflow guides come out of that.

items.role: Coder, Website designer & CTO, I Love Digital
items.detail: I make websites, search, socials and technology simple for Queensland businesses.
I led the product team that delivered apps for the live auction industry, aviation, charities and the NRL.
Worked with mining, engineering, oil and gas and IT businesses finding and filling roles Australia-wide.
Assessed, wrote and managed commercial and business loans for a wide range of Australian businesses.
In my spare time I volunteer at the Vipers Basketball Club, serve on the Committee, and coach junior teams at the club and representative level.
